title: Chicken Kheema Samosa from scratch 🔥🥟 crispy & spicy #shorts

segments.moment_description: Cooking the chicken over the fire
Cooking the spiced chicken kheema filling

description:
Chicken Kheema Samosa 🔥🥟 — crispy golden samosas stuffed with spicy minced-chicken kheema, fried till shatter-crisp. The ultimate non-veg tea-time snack, made from scratch.

Chicken kheema or classic aloo samosa — which one are you biting first? 👇 Comment!

🌿 Filled with minced chicken cooked with onion, ginger-garlic, green chilli and garam masala, wrapped in crisp samosa pastry.

Did you know? 'Kheema' means spiced minced meat, and samosas travelled to India from Central Asia centuries ago — the meat-filled version is closest to the original.
